finding.observed: In first pass within loop over wave_number=1:29, the indexed read expression is fixed to 1.wav, whereas the second pass does use wave_number.wav. Consequently every first-pass peak is derived from 1.wav, not each separate WAV, and max_sample does not in general bound every processed file's normalized peak.
finding.synthetic_counterexample: File 1 has samples [1,-1] (RMS 1, crest factor 1). File 2 has [1,0,0,0] (RMS 0.5, crest factor 2). The written first-pass global scale is 1, so the computed second-pass file-2 peak is 2, above unity. This is a mathematical synthetic illustration, not a measurement of the authors' stimuli or MATLAB output behavior.
finding.potential_consequence: If a real other input has larger normalized peaks than 1.wav, the intended per-file/global peak bound cannot be guaranteed by this released script; output writer behavior, actual stimulus distortion and its effect on participants remain unverified.
